scheme_name: Cost of Spectacle for the Construction Workers
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of West Bengal.
Applicant must be a Building/Construction Worker.
Applicant must be aged between 18 and 60 years.
Applicant must have worked in building and construction for at least 90 days in a year.
Applicant must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal.
Applicant must pay a registration fee of ₹20 and a yearly subscription fee of ₹30 (renewal fee of ₹30 after one year).
benefits_summary: Up to ₹500 reimbursement for purchasing spectacles.
